description: Reminds every session to run kc-ready-for-review before a PR goes to a reviewer, and the kit's maintainer to ship lessons; keeps its marketplace's plugins updated during a session and says when the session runs an older kc-gates than is installed; blocks GitHub review writes (PR and issue comments, reviews) that lack the KC_REVIEW_POST_APPROVED=1 approval token, and PR hand-offs to review (gh pr ready, a ready gh pr create, adding a reviewer) whose head commit has no kc-ready-for-review receipt, and draft PRs too where the repo's hand-off checklist says drafts: true; after a command that approves or merges a pull request, reminds Claude that the look-back is due; and holds back a reply that says what instructions require without reading them that turn, or hands the person an account CLI's command without having checked that CLI
